rationale: Near-bus, mid-feeder, and remote-end faults were computed from source plus transformer plus feeder impedance to each location. The maximum three-phase current is the near-bus fault, the minimum two-phase current is the remote-end fault, the 1.1 breaker margin requires 10.234 kA so the smallest feasible standard rating is 12.5 kA, and 500 A is between the 450 A load-margin minimum and the 754.055 A sensitivity maximum.
